description: The Hinterdorf is the old quarter of Zermatt, a lane of dark wooden storehouses and barns raised on staddle stones. This replaces the Gornergrat Matterhorn view, already published, and it is not the Bahnhofstrasse or the Findeln shelf. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 11°C, with a breeze, very dry air, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
